productionPain: Chapter content is configuration-driven, but the active chapter authority is large and cross-linked. Authors need deterministic validation, semantic preview, diff and rollback evidence before a specialized visual editor is justified.

bottlenecks.evidence: Nodes, rooms, NPCs, interactables, conditions, results, rewards and encounters use foreign keys across multiple collections.
The active chapter authority is 31,503 lines and 1,012,574 bytes at the measured commit.
A configuration row must be checked through ChapterSession, condition/result execution and CombatSession routing before browser acceptance.
The generic chapter schema has one test package, no production package and intentionally permits extension fields.

options.reason: Low maintenance cost, but it does not provide semantic foreign-key validation, compact preview or rollback evidence.
Uses the existing JSON authority while adding headless validation, preview, semantic diff and hash-verified rollback evidence with low maintenance cost.
The generic schema and production author workflow are not yet stable enough to justify a second UI surface and its maintenance burden.

workflow.undoStrategy: Source control remains the undo authority. The inspection tool records baseline, changed and rollback hashes; it never mutates the input package.
workflow.previewBehavior: Emit a compact machine-readable summary of chapter identity, collection counts, referenced encounter IDs, result categories and semantic findings.
workflow.versioning: schemaVersion on every chapter package; migrations require a new schema version and fixture pair.
workflow.migration: No migration is required for v1. A future version must ship forward and rollback fixtures before activation.
workflow.batchOperations: Deferred until at least three production chapter packages expose a repeated bulk operation.
workflow.sourceControl: Review JSON and semantic diff together; generated preview/report files remain ignored evidence.

reconsiderEditorWhen: At least three production chapter packages use a stable schema version.
At least two non-programmer authors repeat the workflow for four weeks.
Measured validation or cross-reference mistakes exceed two per chapter iteration after script-tool adoption.
Median chapter iteration time remains above four hours after the script workflow is adopted.
risks: The active chapter-one document is not yet represented one-to-one by the generic chapter package schema.
A compact preview cannot replace real-browser interaction and manual visual acceptance.
Reference assets may support development preview but cannot satisfy production ownership or release gates.
